capabilities: Edit table cells directly in Live Preview
Merge, split, insert, delete, and reorder rows and columns
Sort selected columns with numeric, text, and multi-step modes
Fill series including dates and calendar cycles
disambiguation: Not related to ByteDance's VTable (VisActor); it is an Obsidian table editor with no affiliation to that library.
extras: Ships an optional external AI skill (vtable-syntax) for generating table source. Series fill is desktop-only; triple-backtick fenced code blocks inside cells are unsupported. Installable from community plugins, BRAT, or manually.
problem: Native Markdown tables cannot hold merged cells, multi-line cells, formulas, or task checkboxes, and are awkward to edit.
summary: Table editor that stores enhanced tables in a ```vtable code block, adding merged cells, formulas, charts, and Markdown/HTML conversion.
